name: Kano≒Kare≒Kanojo
source:
The boundary between man and woman.
The moment when I become a 'girlfriend'.

A prickly boy Rin has a secret job that even his girlfriend doesn't know. 

That is the badger game in crossdressing costume. He deceives 
and blackmails middle-aged guys into paying money.

But he will pay the price of the misdeeds he has accumulated...

The casual crossdressing will make him awaken to his inner femslut.

An ADV game that depicts his change in mind in detail.

男人与女人的界线。
我变成“女朋友”的那一刻。
